description: Extracts real foreground and background color pairs from CSS instead of guessing roles from token names. Pass a public `url` (the page, its style blocks and up to 12 linked stylesheets are fetched) or paste `css` (and optionally `html` for its style blocks). For every rule that sets `color`, it finds the background set by the same rule, by an ancestor named in the selector, or by body/html, resolves var() custom properties, light-dark() and prefers-color-scheme / [data-theme] / .dark variants, and applies opacity. Returns WCAG ratio, APCA Lc, the threshold (large text 3, otherwise 4.5), file and line for each failing pair, a list of thin margins, a list of pairs whose background is assumed (only the page root or the browser default was available), and text over images or gradients that cannot be computed. Optional `scheme` (both, light, dark) and `viewport` (width in px for min-width/max-width media queries, default 1280). Reads CSS only: no rendering, inline style attributes, script, or text over photographs.

html.description: Optional HTML whose <style> blocks are read.

scheme.description: Which color scheme to evaluate. Default both.

url.description: A public page URL to fetch.

viewport.description: Viewport width in px for width media queries. Default 1280.
